name: validate-storydir-inside-gitroot
title: Early-validate storyDir resolves inside the resolved gitRoot
description: When a project configures gitRoot to a subdirectory (wrapper-root layout) and storyDir resolves OUTSIDE that gitRoot, the git-backed lifecycle only fails LATE: at INIT_CHECK worktree bootstrap (worktree.ts:754) and the metadata reconcile/merge (cli-engine.ts:3367), with the message: story metadata is not inside the resolved git root. By then the user has already invested INIT and PLAN work. A grep confirms the ONLY two detection sites are these late guards; there is no early detection at config load, story_create, doctor, or session_brief. Add early, clear detection of the storyDir-not-inside-gitRoot invariant so users learn immediately with the remediation. Reuse the exact relative-path escape logic the two guards already use (realpath both sides; violation when rel is empty, absolute, or contains a .. segment). Surface via lattice doctor and an early advisory; in PLAN weigh hard-fail vs warn at story_create because existing wrapper-root projects currently limp along.
